items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: he was so proud of the fact that he taught Steve Allen how to play the clarinet for “The Benny Goodman Story.”

ctx.x: He was about the least talented fella there. Nice guy. And he was so proud of the fact that he taught Steve Allen how to play the clarinet for “The Benny Goodman Story.”
